## Change classification

- [ ] Public behavior changed
- [ ] SDK API changed
- [ ] Configuration changed
- [ ] Security behavior changed
- [ ] Error codes changed
- [ ] Compatibility changed
- [ ] Migration required

## Documentation and examples

- [ ] Canonical `latchway/docs/public` source updated first
- [ ] Generated mirror checkpoint refreshed by the core synchronizer
- [ ] Examples updated and compiled
- [ ] Agent skill updated when its workflow changed
- [ ] Documentation is not required and the `docs-not-required` label is applied
